drivers.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
drivers.detail: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027. (Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
drivers.detail: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
drivers.detail: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
drivers.detail: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing. (Cointelegraph, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Securitize shares surge 12% in after-hours trading on Q3 results and River One acquisition agreement
drivers.detail: The acquisition is expected to add a new layer of financing to Securitize, enabling the platform to offer asset-backed lending. (The Block.)
